description: Explicit synthetic load/calibration assumptions, NOT physical measurements.
notes: Arrival rate is requests/second, NOT total number of simulation replications.
Demand is steady-state equivalent vCPU with utilization/headroom, not the number of sequential retries.
Memory represents resident peak per service, not per attempt; concurrency may require separate measurements.
MB used in network resource blocks is treated as decimal MB; message kB and Mbps are decimal.
Service-graph logical dependencies are not assumed data transfers unless explicitly labeled.
Network graph and original professor solver are kept byte-for-byte unchanged.
Mixed cost coefficients are called reference cost units; not validated monetary cost.
